patterns: jeans and tops for pear body
responses:
Body Type: Pear 💖
Jeans: Bootcut, wide-leg, and high-waisted jeans help balance wider hips 👖✨
Tops: Off-shoulder, puff sleeves, and detailed necklines enhance your upper body 👚
Occasion Wear: A-line lehengas, flared anarkalis, and embellished blouses 👗
Styling Tip: Highlight your upper body with brighter colors 💫

Body Type: Apple 💖
Jeans: Straight-leg and high-waisted jeans provide structure 👖
Tops: Flowy tops and V-necks create a balanced silhouette 👚✨
Occasion Wear: Anarkalis, sarees with flowy drapes, and simple kurtis 👗
Styling Tip: Avoid overly tight waist fits 💫

Body Type: Hourglass 💖
Jeans: Skinny and high-waisted jeans highlight your natural curves 👖✨
Tops: Fitted tops, wrap styles, and crop tops enhance your waist 👚
Occasion Wear: Well-fitted lehengas, sarees, and crop-top sets 👗
Styling Tip: Emphasize your waist and avoid overly loose outfits 💫

Body Type: Rectangle 💖
Jeans: Mom jeans, flared jeans, and mid-rise styles create curves 👖✨
Tops: Peplum tops, ruffles, and layered designs add dimension 👚
Occasion Wear: Layered lehengas, shararas, and detailed kurtis 👗
Styling Tip: Add volume to both upper and lower body 💫

Body Type: Inverted Triangle 💖
Jeans: Straight-leg, bootcut, and wide-leg jeans balance broader shoulders 👖✨
Tops: Keep tops simple and avoid heavy shoulder detailing 👚
Occasion Wear: Flowy lehengas, sarees with heavy bottoms, and shararas 👗
Styling Tip: Focus attention on the lower body 💫

Body Type: Lean Column 💖
Jeans: Slim-fit, straight, and slightly flared jeans add subtle curves 👖✨
Tops: Layered tops, textured fabrics, and crop tops enhance shape 👚
Occasion Wear: Structured lehengas, layered anarkalis, and shararas 👗
Styling Tip: Use layers and textures to create dimension 💫

patterns: what should I wear to a party
responses: For a party 💃, go for a bold outfit like a fitted dress, stylish jumpsuit, or trendy co-ord set ✨ Pair it with statement accessories 💖
Party outfits should stand out 💫—try sleek dresses, crop-top sets, or elegant sarees 👗✨
For college 🎒, keep it comfortable yet stylish—jeans with tops, kurtis, or casual shirts 👖👚✨
A smart college look 💖 includes relaxed fits, minimal accessories, and breathable fabrics 💫
For casual wear 🌸, go with comfortable outfits like t-shirts, jeans, and simple dresses 👖👗✨
Casual styling 💫 is all about comfort—choose easy-going outfits with good fit and soft colors 💖
